strategic_capability_mapping.relationship: Existing headless run-control RPCs carry terminal completion evidence so scheduled callers can stop on runtime-owned completion fingerprints.
M22.1 task-run completion evidence is reused as the terminal agent-loop completion contract for headless step and stop decisions.
Headless advance and drive ledger events can persist bounded completion evidence without raw prompts, provider responses, final responses, or file content.

answers.strategic_capabilities: Advances headless_autonomous_development with supporting agent_loop and persistent_structured_ledger behavior.
answers.new_capability: Existing headless.run.advance and headless.run.drive results expose terminal TaskRunCompletionEvidence for task-run steps and drive stop decisions.
answers.why_existing_functionality_is_insufficie: Direct task.run completion evidence does not provide headless session checkpoint, drive stop reason, or replay-safe run-control decision data.
answers.product_gap_if_skipped: Headless controllers would still infer terminal completion from nested task-run or ledger details after drive/advance.
answers.non_duplicative: Yes. M22.1 covered direct task-run completion evidence, M21.1 covered Mode Pack policy revalidation, and M20.2 covered provider retry execution.
answers.no_new_rpc: Yes. This extends existing headless.run.advance and headless.run.drive result evidence.
answers.no_new_summary: Yes. This is bounded execution step/stop evidence, not a report, digest, history, readiness, preview, or inspection surface.
answers.runtime_behavior_change: Headless advance/drive execution and replay now route terminal task-run completion evidence into bounded checkpoint and stop evidence.
answers.headless_autonomous_contribution: Scheduled callers can stop, persist, and compare terminal completion fingerprints from the same protocol they use to drive work.
answers.milestone_progress: Connects M22.1 completion evidence to headless run-control and should make M22 eligible for closeout after merge.

review_value_gate.review_intent: M22.2 must be reviewed for actual headless run-control step/stop evidence and replay invariants, not for a new completion report or inspection surface.

guard_engine_change_review.review_intent: M22.2 changes the current phase manifest only; guard engine changes are not expected.

exit_criteria: headless.run.advance returns terminal completion evidence when a task-run step reaches terminal completion with M22.1 evidence
headless.run.drive returns terminal completion evidence as bounded stop evidence when the drive stops at a terminal task boundary
Headless completion evidence fingerprints match direct task.run completion evidence fingerprints
Repeated advance and drive calls replay stable completion evidence without duplicate task or headless ledger mutation
Stale-progress, budget, and no-runnable-work paths remain bounded and do not invent terminal completion evidence
No new RPC, report, history, digest, readiness, preview, or inspection wrapper is introduced
next_phase_candidate_notes: If M22.2 merges and review confirms direct task.run and headless run-control both carry replay-safe completion evidence, move M22 to milestone closeout rather than creating a wrapper-only M22.3.
